answer: A proof-of-space protocol binds each agent's identity to unique plotting tables verified through a decentralized prism network. Nodes must periodically prove continuous custody of non-compressible data initialized across a cold tundra tier. An attacker incurs a verifiable marginal cost in dedicated drive storage and bus bandwidth per synthesized agent. However, periodic challenge latency slows consensus, opening an economic canyon that penalizes lightweight edge devices.
